routes.name: audit_integrity
routes.description:
Verifies the cryptographic hash chain of audit log records.
التحقق من سلامة سلسلة تجزئة سجل التدقيق.

Each audit log entry contains SHA-256(prev_hash + record_data).
Any tampering with a record or deletion of records breaks the chain.

- Returns `"intact"` if no tampering detected
- Returns `"tampered"` with details of which records were modified
- Returns the last verified hash for external storage/verification

**Access:** admin or master_admin only

routes.name: audit_summary

routes.name: get_dhis2_aggregate
routes.summary: DHIS2 aggregate data export for MoH reporting
routes.description:
Returns aggregate lab statistics in DHIS2-compatible format.
إحصائيات المختبر التجميعية بتنسيق DHIS2.

DHIS2 (District Health Information Software 2) is used by Iraq's Ministry
of Health across 1,848 health institutions for national health reporting.
This endpoint exports non-patient-identifying aggregate counts suitable
for submission to the MoH DHIS2 national health information system.

Data exported: total tests by type, result flag distribution, monthly counts.
No patient PII is included in this response.

routes.name: get_fhir_diagnostic_report

DiagnosticReport is the primary FHIR resource for lab results — it wraps

Required for Ministry of Health interoperability and DHIS2 integration.

routes.name: get_fhir_observations

ServiceRequest represents the original test order from a clinician.

routes.name: deep_health

routes.name: health_deep
routes.description:
Deep diagnostic endpoint — comprehensive latency + queue + memory snapshot.
Designed for monitoring dashboards and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.).

Returns overall health grade:
  GREEN   — all components healthy, latencies normal
  YELLOW  — degraded performance, some components slow
  RED     — one or more critical components failing

Always returns HTTP 200 — check 'grade' field for actual state.
Accessible without authentication (all values are non-sensitive metrics).

routes.name: kernel_health
routes.description:
Kernel health and diagnostics.
Returns the Kernel's internal state, component status, and uptime.
Bypasses all middlewares so it is always reachable.

routes.name: liveness
routes.description: Kubernetes-style liveness probe - always returns 200 if process is alive.

routes.name: readiness_health
routes.description: Readiness probe — DB, Redis and degradation state.

routes.name: readiness
routes.description:
Hybrid readiness probe — startup completed AND services still alive.

Returns 200 only when:
  1. Startup guard completed successfully (all steps passed), AND
  2. Database is currently reachable, AND
  3. Redis cache is currently reachable.

If DB or Redis fail after startup, this probe turns 503 again — the
Docker healthcheck will detect it and trigger a container restart.

routes.name: detailed_health
routes.description: Detailed health status — always visible so operators can diagnose startup failures.

routes.name: health_status
routes.description:
Full diagnostic status — shows exactly why the system is or isn't ready.
Useful for debugging startup failures without needing server access.
Always returns 200 — check 'ready' field for actual state.

routes.name: get_patient_history_route

Requires 'name' query param matching full patient name as verification.

Multi-tenant isolation: the phone number may belong to Patient records in
multiple labs (each lab keeps its own patient roster).  We aggregate results
across ALL labs where the phone+name pair matches, so the citizen sees their
complete history regardless of which lab they visited.  Only the patient's
own results are returned — no cross-patient data is possible.

routes.name: list_pending_review
routes.description:
Admin queue of identity claims awaiting adjudication.

These are matches where the probabilistic score landed in the fuzzy band
(THRESHOLD_REVIEW ≤ score < THRESHOLD_AUTO). Leaving them unreviewed
either loses cross-lab linkage (false negative) or conflates two real
people (false positive, catastrophic at national scale).

routes.name: decide_pending_review
routes.description:
Confirm or reject an ambiguous claim.

confirm → match_method becomes 'manual' (audit-preserved), the claim stays.
reject  → detach from the current citizen and mint a new canonical one,
          so the lab patient gets its own record. Writes a MergeAudit row
          so the decision is hash-chained.
